name: Listening room
thesis: Each story is a carefully framed object in a quiet room, given space to hold your attention before you choose to enter it.
difference: A warm limestone canvas, fine ivory image mats, olive controls and a Newsreader-led serif voice borrow from exhibition rooms; the image precedes the centered title, while a low floating four-stop dock keeps the collection and the exit within reach.
tradeoff: The framed-image composition feels composed and tactile, but its calm consistency offers less visual energy and fewer immediate source details than a more editorial approach.
lens: Museum exhibition and listening-room designer: careful framing, presence and quiet materiality.
